items.title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark warns AI needs a 'brake pedal' - BBC
items.snippet: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark has called for the ability to slow progression o...
items.raw_snippet: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark has called for the ability to slow progression of artificial intelligence (AI), warning the technology is nearing a point where it could develop without human input. "Right now, it's like the AI industry has a gas pedal, but it doesn't have a brake pedal.". "The world needs to do some thinking and we need to eventually develop some new regulations that allow us to be confident in these systems," he said. Clark did not outline how a "brake pedal" for AI research and development could be created, but drew a parallel between AI and the oil boom and barons of the turn of the last century. "Society's response was to come up with a sensible policy and regulatory framework that gave people confidence in oil and the benefits that oil could provide to the world, and meant that you didn't have to worry about the personalities of the people leading the companies", Clark said.
